primary_rule.action: When a feature signature occurs in more than one partition, retain it only in the highest-priority partition.
primary_rule.environment_samples: Preserved to retain the previously frozen 2,000 observations per class per block.
primary_rule.group_definition: Identical cleaned values across all 49 model predictors.
primary_rule.post_purge_balancing: Training, calibration and source-test partitions are independently downsampled to equal benign and attack counts.
primary_rule.signature_method: Pandas deterministic 64-bit row hash; collision probability is negligible at the audited sample sizes.
primary_rule.within_partition_multiplicity: Retained in the primary analysis to preserve observed traffic frequency.

reason: The pre-modelling audit detected identical 49-feature signatures across source partitions.
timing: Created after data-quality auditing but before model training, feature-importance estimation, or cross-dataset evaluation.
